blurb: Guests can enjoy go-kart racing on indoor and outdoor tracks, laser tag in a 6,000 sq ft arena, an 18-hole mini golf course, an indoor play area for kids 12 and under, arcade games, and mini bowling. The facility offers birthday party packages and event spaces for groups and corporate events. Attractions are pay-as-you-play or available via all-day passes and special deals.
extraNote: Go-Kart track rentals require 50% non-refundable deposit · Party reservations require $50 non-refundable deposit and 14-day advance booking · Special offers require presenting coupon at time of visit, not valid with other offers
